title: Prefer the latest stable Rust edition in Cargo manifests
abstract: When choosing a Rust package edition, set the Cargo.toml [package].edition field to the newest stable Rust edition supported by the project's toolchain and compatibility requirements. 'Latest' is resolved at the time the setting is chosen, not treated as a fixed calendar year.

provisional_conflict_analysis.reason: Values coincide while the latest stable supported edition is 2024; they can diverge when a newer edition becomes available and compatible. Modal strength and applicability control whether divergence amounts to a genuine conflict.

unresolved: Clarify whether newest means the newest stable edition overall or the newest stable edition compatible with the declared MSRV.
Specify whether this is an obligation, preference, strong permission, or weak permission; do not silently assume.
Define whether this governs new manifests only or migrations of existing crates.

public_reference_context.observed_fact: Rust 2024 is currently documented as the latest stable Cargo edition, so these proposals are not presently value-incompatible solely on the edition year.
public_reference_context.note: Observation is temporal background, not frozen normative content; latest stable may change in the future.
